messages.body:
Dear Amber User and Developer.
Our Lab will upgrade some server to RTX 3080, unfortunately the Amber
software still in Amber18.
Is RTX 3080 compatible with Amber18?
I mean, if we using RTX3080 in our server, can we still install Amber18 and
running well ?
